name: Soft Studio 3D
description: Soft product-photo 3D style: pastel soft-matte materials, one warm key with a wide soft shadow, a long lens at a three-quarter angle and slow dolly and glide moves. A style only: the agent builds the table, the props and the products from scratch for each video, so no two videos share a scene. No emoji.
prompt_hint: 6-10 scenes (3-6 s). Each: title.kicker + title.main, visual.type "scene3d" with a `world` (concept, ground, backdrop, parts) and 1-3 `custom` subjects designed for THIS video's topic; never a stock desk, books or plant. Try two or three `shots` per scene (wide, close, low). No emoji.
